description.it: Entra in SSH nel nodo e esplora i componenti Kubernetes in esecuzione.
description.en: SSH into the node and explore the running Kubernetes components.

hint.it: Usa 'minikube ssh' poi 'docker ps' per vedere i container del control plane.
hint.en: Use 'minikube ssh' then 'docker ps' to see control plane containers.

description.it: Determina quale container runtime sta usando il cluster Minikube.
description.en: Determine which container runtime the Minikube cluster is using.

hint.it: In SSH: 'docker info' o 'crictl --version' rivelano il runtime.
hint.en: In SSH: 'docker info' or 'crictl --version' reveal the runtime.

description.it: Ottieni l'indirizzo IP del nodo Minikube e verifica la raggiungibilità.
description.en: Get the IP address of the Minikube node and verify reachability.

hint.it: 'minikube ip' mostra l'IP. Prova 'ping' o 'curl' verso quel nodo.
hint.en: 'minikube ip' shows the IP. Try 'ping' or 'curl' to that node.

description.it: Esamina il file di configurazione di Minikube.

hint.it: Il file è in ~/.minikube/config/config.json. Usa 'cat' o 'minikube config view'.
hint.en: The file is in ~/.minikube/config/config.json. Use 'cat' or 'minikube config view'.

description.it: Trova e ispeziona i certificati TLS usati dal cluster.
description.en: Find and inspect the TLS certificates used by the cluster.

hint.it: I cert sono in ~/.minikube/ o in /var/lib/minikube/certs dentro il nodo.
hint.en: Certs are in ~/.minikube/ or in /var/lib/minikube/certs inside the node.

description.it: Avvia un cluster con driver Docker e uno con VirtualBox, confronta i tempi.
description.en: Start a cluster with Docker driver and one with VirtualBox, compare times.

description.it: Recupera informazioni dettagliate sull'API server Kubernetes.
description.en: Retrieve detailed information about the Kubernetes API server.

hint.it: 'kubectl cluster-info' mostra endpoint. 'kubectl get --raw='/healthz' per health check.
hint.en: 'kubectl cluster-info' shows endpoints. 'kubectl get --raw='/healthz' for health check.

description.it: Verifica che etcd sia in esecuzione e integro.
description.en: Verify that etcd is running and healthy.

hint.it: In SSH: 'docker ps | grep etcd' o 'kubectl get pods -n kube-system | grep etcd'.
hint.en: In SSH: 'docker ps | grep etcd' or 'kubectl get pods -n kube-system | grep etcd'.

description.it: Configura l'ambiente Docker per puntare a Minikube ed esegui un container.
description.en: Configure Docker environment to point to Minikube and run a container.

description.it: Disegna un diagramma dei componenti del tuo cluster Minikube.
description.en: Draw a diagram of your Minikube cluster components.

hint.it: Includi: control plane pods, kubelet, kube-proxy, container runtime, rete.
hint.en: Include: control plane pods, kubelet, kube-proxy, container runtime, network.
